L'heure en direct dans les villes de ton: The live time in the cities of your choice: time to the second, date, offset from you and day or night, daylight saving included. Add a city by typing its name, remove it in one click, and shift every clock by up to 24 hours to know what time it will be there. Each city gets a pixel-art analog clock in front of its sky: day, dawn, dusk or starry night, with the sun or moon along its arc. Bigger text, and the grid follows the screen size.
